description: Target enzyme systems for the allosteric-pocket / metal-switch demo. Each system lists PDB structures forming an 'active vs inactive' or 'apo vs ligand-bound' pair used to detect distal conformational responses (Ca displacement, hinge/interface motion) by structural alignment.

systems.name: Human glucokinase (hexokinase-4)
systems.role: positive control (large domain motion; known small-molecule allosteric activator site)

systems.name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B
systems.role: positive control (known distal allosteric inhibitor site ~20 A from catalytic Cys; WPD-loop coupling)
systems.reference: Wiesmann et al. 2004, Nat Struct Mol Biol 11:730-737

structures.state: allosteric-inhibitor bound (WPD open, catalytic loop locked)

systems.name: Adenylate kinase
systems.role: engineering target (large open/closed motion; clear hinge; de novo Zn-switch candidate)
systems.reference: Muller & Schulz 1992 J Mol Biol 224:159; Muller et al. 1996 Structure 4:147

systems.name: ATP-dependent 6-phosphofructokinase
systems.role: oligomeric allostery benchmark (natural effector site; ADP/Mg2+ activation)
systems.reference: Shirakihara & Evans 1988 J Mol Biol 204:973; Rypniewski & Evans 1990 J Mol Biol 213:159

systems.name: TEM-1 beta-lactamase (scaffold for cpTEM-1 metal-switch replication)
systems.role: literature replication scaffold (His-pair/His-triplet metal modulation); circular-permutant constructs have no direct PDB, use sequence

systems.name: Aspartate transcarbamoylase
systems.oligomeric_state: A6B6 dodecamer (2 catalytic trimers + 3 regulatory dimers)
systems.role: classic strong-allostery benchmark (T/R transition, regulatory subunit interfaces)
systems.reference: Huang & Lipscomb 2004 (1D09, R-state PALA); Kim et al. 1987 (T-state)

systems.name: Glycogen phosphorylase, liver form
systems.role: drug-target allosteric benchmark (AMP site / allosteric inhibitor stabilizing tense state)
systems.reference: Human liver GP tense state with AVE5688 (3CEH)
